scope: A targeted SEC filing follow-up conceived after opening the initial QLoRA trial. The original five results remain public. Only the SEC routing policy changes.

training.features: Final real-token Qwen hidden state for each legal menu layout, L2-normalized separately and averaged.
training.head: Centered dual ridge fit on development-independent training rows and one-hot filing labels, then project scores onto a nonnegative normalized distribution.
training.selection: Maximum exact accuracy on the locked original development IDs. Prefer the smaller readout weight and larger regularization on ties.

evaluation.primary: Paired change in exact 8-K section accuracy versus the unadapted base with the same two option layouts.
evaluation.blocks: Previously unused SEC CIK. One section per issuer.
evaluation.confirmation: Positive paired 95% block-bootstrap interval and one-sided paired block sign-flip p below 0.05 for this single preregistered panel.
evaluation.secondary: Validation-selected TF-IDF word or word plus character logistic baseline on the same fresh cases. If this stronger reference wins, report it.
evaluation.reference_retention: FinQA and the optimizer intervention routes keep the previously evaluated QLoRA weights and scorer. Do not retune them on the initial held-out predictions.
